_doc: Option B of the wing-layer plan, on the MP4/5 only (same mesh as the c13/p14: h0 0.34, 2 jobs like the c13). In the c13 the layer addition extruded 73 % of the faces at first and ended at 62.6 % (wings 61/77 %): most faces were lost to non-orthogonality > 65 (strict for the first 20 iterations although the final mesh accepts 75) and to tet quality. c16: featureAngle 180 (mergePatchFacesAngle kept at 130), maxThicknessToMedialRatio 1, minMedialAxisAngle 30, nSmoothThickness 2, relaxed quality (maxNonOrtho 75) from the first iteration. c17: the same plus nOuterIter 3 with nGrow -1 (layers added in 3 passes, OpenFOAM v2206+). The MFT03 run f03_p15 (run 44706113967) keeps going.
